notes.title: BIG UPDATE – Major Gameplay Overhaul!
notes.notes: [p][b]Hello bar managers,[/b][/p][p]We’re thrilled to release the biggest update yet for [b]Beach Bar Simulator[/b], packed with new systems, features, and improvements that will transform your bar management experience![/p][p][b]What’s included in this update:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]New cashier system[/b] – Customers now place their orders at the cashier before heading to their seats, bringing a more realistic flow to the gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New coffee machines & grinders[/b] – Expanded brewing possibilities with brand new equipment.[/p][/*][*][p][b]12 new coffee types[/b] – Beyond Doppio and Espresso, you can now serve a full menu of coffee varieties.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New cup sizes[/b] – In addition to the mini size, small, medium, and large cups are now available.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Syrups and milk options[/b] – Customize drinks with added flavors and dairy choices.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Updated customer reactions[/b] – Improved AI responses to match your service quality.[/p][/*][*][p][b]No more time limit[/b] – The old day timer has been replaced with a [b]level system[/b]. You can play freely until you reach Level 4. After that, you’ll keep running your bar with the unlocked content.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sleeping system[/b] – End your day by heading to your caravan to rest and prepare for the next shift.[/p][/*][/list][p]This update marks a huge step forward in making [b]Beach Bar Simulator[/b] more immersive and feature-rich. We can’t wait to hear your thoughts and feedback![/p][p]Thank you for supporting the game and helping shape its future development. Don’t forget to add it to your Steam wishlist and share your experience with the community![/p]

notes.title: Control Update – More Intuitive Interactions!
notes.notes:
[p][b][i]Hello bar managers,[/i][/b][/p][p]We’ve just released a new update focused on improving how you interact with the environment in Beach Bar Simulator. This quality-of-life change simplifies the control scheme, making the gameplay smoother and more intuitive.[/p][h3]What’s included in this update:[/h3][list][*][p]Actions that previously required holding the [b]R[/b] key or tapping [b]E[/b] have been removed[/p][/*][*][p]All main interactions are now performed using a [b]single left mouse click[/b][/p][/*][*][p]This includes picking up items, interacting with stations, and serving customers[/p][/*][*][p]The goal is to reduce confusion and improve overall responsiveness[/p][/*][/list][p]This update is based on feedback from the community and is part of our continued effort to refine the core experience ahead of the full release.[/p][p]Thank you for playing and helping shape the development of Beach Bar Simulator.
Don’t forget to add the game to your Steam wishlist to stay informed about future updates.[/p]

notes.title: New Horizons Update – Sea & Sky Rework + Fixes
notes.notes: [p]Hello bar managers,[/p][p]We're excited to release a new visual update that brings a fresh look and feel to Beach Bar Simulator. This patch focuses on improving the overall atmosphere, refining key visuals, and fixing bugs for a smoother gameplay experience.[/p][p][b]What’s included in this update:[/b][/p][list][*][p]A completely reworked [b]ocean shader[/b] with improved reflections, lighting, and wave detail[/p][/*][*][p]A brand new [b]skybox[/b] that enhances the tropical setting with dynamic colors and depth[/p][/*][*][p]Multiple [b]bug fixes[/b] and minor improvements to UI and scene polish[/p][/*][*][p]Better overall visual coherence and lighting balance across the play area[/p][/*][/list][p]This update is part of our ongoing effort to enhance the game's core experience before full release. We're actively listening to your feedback and continuously improving based on it.[/p][p]Thank you for playing and supporting the development. Don't forget to add Beach Bar Simulator to your wishlist on Steam to stay up to date.[/p]
